scope: JAX-CFD N64, matched seed0 H8/H16 selected checkpoints; input-restricted spectra not full Jacobian conditioning
trajectory_definition: Each arm starts from identical developed fine-reference state then follows its own autonomous trajectory; states diverge. Local controls evaluated at identical x and S(x).
normalization: Same original case0 RMS channel scales for every state,map,IC,checkpoint,basis
attenuation_caveat: Viscosity/diffusion legitimately damp high modes; small singular values and large condition ratios are not evidence of AD failure. Raw sigma_min and raw ratio retained; numerical rank is separately reported.
restriction: 24 physical input modes; velocity curl satisfies discrete divergence/normal boundaries; scalar cosine Neumann modes. Full12288-dimensional output retained, no output projection. Three genuinely different mode subsets, not basis rotations.
bands: DCT spatial coefficient radial bands <=4,4..16,>16. Curl and walls mix observed DCT bands: input leakage recorded. Damping is not necessarily improved forward accuracy.
prediction_error: Autonomous prediction restarted at developed fine-reference state, compared to corresponding later fine-reference target; not original rollout from time0
